name: base
description: Morita: a tiny skinny female toy poodle puppy, same apricot curly fur and same pixel art style as the reference dog Tofu, but smaller, thinner and more delicate: slim narrow body, thin legs, slightly sunken belly, fluffy curly ears. She wears a pink collar and a small pink ribbon bow on one ear. Standing in three-quarter view facing right, full body, shy and a little sad, hungry expression, head slightly lowered, tail down. Clean dark outline, vivid colors, transparent background, single character, no text, no shadow.
